Composition & Indication

Cefixime 400mg — 5 Tablets (Generic for Suprax®) contains Cefixime Trihydrate 400 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 5 Tablets at the official 400mg strength. The standard indication is the management of bacterial infections (urinary tract, respiratory, ear), per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Cefixime 400mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.
